summary_1line: Rama and Lakshmana discover the mortally wounded Jatayu, who reveals Ravana abducted Sita after he tried to rescue her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama and Lakshmana discover the gigantic vulture Jatayu lying on the forest floor, wings severed and body soaked in blood.
The dying Jatayu, vomiting blood, lifts his head to tell Rama how Ravana carried Sita away through the sky.
Rama drops his bow and cradles the wounded Jatayu in his arms, overcome with grief in the lonely forest.
